takeaways.text: Lines up **Slot** on **67%** of 243 plays (n=162); also Wide (outside) 32% (n=79).
Runs a route on **99%** of dropbacks — about the WR average (100%). Effectively always a receiver; blocking is negligible.
On routes, averages **9.1 yd** downfield by the throw vs 11.2 for WRs (shallower) (n=239, snap→release window only).
Primary alignment is Slot (67%); a coach might set the first coverage answer to that spot. This is a hypothesis from observed tendencies, not a proven assignment.

example_plays.why: closest to his median route depth (7.1 yd) — a normal rep
farthest from his median depth — an outlier, NOT representative
